title: Grok Build remote settings (GET /v1/settings)
description: Informational schema — tracks the `RemoteSettings` struct as of SOURCE_REV 0f4d7c91b8b2b408333f6de1e8a76cb8eaa71899. Server-controlled payload fetched from cli-chat-proxy `GET /v1/settings`; NOT a user-authored config file. Every field is `Option`/`Vec` with `#[serde(default)]`, so nothing is required, unknown keys are tolerated, and `null` deserializes to `None`. Several nested values use tolerant deserializers that coerce wrong types to `None` rather than failing the parse; those fields are described as permissive here. Numeric clamps document the client-honored range (the resolver clamps out-of-range values). [src: crates/codegen/xai-grok-config-types/src/lib.rs:421]
